name: Rimebound Relief
short_role: Close Twinwatch with a recovery-led mixed assault.
question: Can posted specialists survive one branch while a reserve carries the other?
objective: Complete all three assaults and reach Results with at least one living assigned defender.
lesson: The Marshal can sustain committed posts, but every assignment needs an independent answer when the command chain is hunted.

variations.preparation_focus: Pair one assigned specialist with a mobile fallback.
The final pressure favors Harriers over command hunters.
The final pressure combines an armored ram with command disruption.
